links.outcome: Clinician-perceived barriers to implementing the decision tool, including EHR integration
links.effect: Lack of integration with electronic health records was mentioned by respondents (n=18) as a barrier to implementation; user-friendliness was a facilitator.
links.quote: User-friendliness was seen as a facilitator, whereas the need for C reactive protein testing and lack of integration with electronic health records were mentioned as barriers.

screen.reason: Qualitative implementation study using CFIR to evaluate determinants, barriers, and facilitators of deploying the Feverkidstool (a predictive clinical decision support risk tool) among ED clinicians.
